profile.headline: Principal Cyber Software Engineer at Northrop Grumman
profile.summary: Conscientious software engineer with strong skills in designing, developing, and maintaining software applications. Skilled at problem-solving and debugging code to ensure functionality and performance. Proficient in multiple programming languages including Java, Python, and Golang, with solid experience in using frameworks and tools such as Angular, Kubernetes, and Docker. Highly organized with methodical approach to completing projects efficiently and accurately, consistently delivering high-quality work with minimal errors. Looking to improve on becoming a leader in a large technical project.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected and led a large-scale refactoring initiative for a mission-critical distributed workflow application, applying distributed systems methodologies and Kubernetes-native orchestration to achieve 5× connection scalability — enabling dynamic workload distribution, fault-tolerant pod scheduling, and measurably improved per instance throughput across the cluster.
 
Designed and built a custom secure communications library from scratch, enabling developers to rapidly establish encrypted channels across distributed nodes — supporting message bus configuration, chunking, streaming, file transfers, and network traffic control.
 
Designed and developed a workflow task running system in a distributed system in a kubernetes environment
 
Established a full CI/CD pipeline encompassing automated system testing, containerized deployment, and artifact packaging — reducing manual release overhead and improving delivery consistency.

Developed a cross-compiler build process for a C toolchain, enabling multi-platform binary distribution from a single build environment.

Developed on a Full Stack DevOps program that allowed sensor operators to view a dashboard of a sensors and all of its meta data. This allowed operators to view a variety of sensors in a common application.
- Program utilized CI/CD practices using Jenkins and Docker to release software.
- Program's frontend application that allowed to users to view sensor's state of health and meta data was written in Angular.
- Program's backend that acted as a data repository with different microservices that handled REST API calls, alert processing, and custom filtering of data was written in NESTJS.
- The project used automation deployment utilizing helm to deploy the application to a kubernetes cluster on Amazon Web Service EKS.

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description: Designed and developed a web application in vue.js/c# with a MVVM model that allowed users to see their maximo data in a specific view and provide partners clients/vendors/users management. This product was designed from the ground up, requiring a schema design in 3NF and designing the front end as well.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
●	Developed a Rest API for posting HTTP requests to a message bus and transmitting response messages back to a specific server. This project was developed in Java and used apache software for
●	At Honeywell, I learned and worked in a Agile/Scrum environment participating through each step of the project project. 
●	Created and maintained a database with schemas, stored procedures, and triggers in SQLServer. 
●	Developed a python script to read timings within log files for internal use in the company. This python script was mostly used for testing purposes to see how long a specific process in a program took.
●	Developed a communication system between PLCs, a message bus, and other servers through a socket connection. The communication system handled all inbound and outbound messages and provided a way for different types of machines/servers to communicate with each other. The project was developed in Java.
